description: Fork scope: npm and Go pins arrive with the upstream merge (/upstream-review), so Renovate here moves only what the fork pins itself: workflow actions, Docker base digests and the golangci-lint pin. Security fixes come from Dependabot security updates (a repository setting), which Renovate would raise a second time.

customManagers.description: The golangci-lint version test.yml runs with `go run`

packageRules.description: test.yml pins the project's Node floor (lib/node-floor.mjs) for the syntax check; bumping it silently drops the floor from CI, as 647ab019 did. Raise it by hand together with NODE_MIN.
Base image tags follow what upstream ships (the Playwright tag equals the playwright version in package.json), so only a rebuilt digest of the same tag moves here, in one PR for every Dockerfile.
The run line names the v2 module path, so a v3 needs the path changed by hand.
